Package com.smu.example.appendonly

Class MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite

java.lang.Object
com.smu.example.MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite_Common<MTC_AppendOnly_Node_Record,MTC_AppendOnly_Index>
com.smu.example.appendonly.MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite
All Implemented Interfaces:
MTC_AppendOnly_Data_Dao, DaoSupport, MTC_Data_Dao<MTC_AppendOnly_Node_Record,MTC_AppendOnly_Index>
public class MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite extends MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite_Common<MTC_AppendOnly_Node_Record,MTC_AppendOnly_Index> implements MTC_AppendOnly_Data_Dao
SQLite implementation of the Data Access Object for Merkle Tree operations.

Kept as a lightweight, dependency-free reference/local-testing implementation; the production deployment uses MTC_Data_Dao_MySQL instead. See CLAUDE.md.
